name: backend_flush_after
description: Number of pages (each 8 kB) written by a single backend after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.
symptoms: High transaction latency due to delayed writeback
Storage write amplification under heavy concurrent writes
Inconsistent I/O patterns causing bursty disk utilization
Increased risk of data loss on crash when set too high
tuning_tips: Set to a small nonzero value (e.g., 32–128) to smooth I/O and reduce latency spikes; avoid 0 in write-heavy or durability-sensitive workloads. Monitor 'pg_stat_bgwriter' for 'buffers_backend_fsync' frequency.
